text: Appeal of Order to Comply (May 17, 2019) for 109 Jameson Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated May 17, 2019, regarding the property located at 109 Jameson Avenue, Folder No. 19 153497 PRS 00 IV - Exterior Common Elements, and in so doing granted an extension to November 18, 2019.
